Hi All,
I don't understand something happening when deploying my App. I try to deploy an App, the then in the error log I can see, that a package "BiocInstaller" was installed, and then multiple other packages, many of which don't seem relevant to my app. The whole log is pasted below. The server file of my app only includes these packages:

library(shiny)
library(shinysky)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ggrepel)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(DT)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)

I would very much appeciate an explanation of what can be possibly going on here.
Cheers,
Lech
